# Support — ai-stack

## Documentation

- **[README.md](../README.md)** — Architecture overview, configuration reference, and quick start
- **[HOWTO.md](../HOWTO.md)** — Task-oriented guide covering installation, models, RAG, GPU, scaling, compliance, and troubleshooting
- **[docs/compliance/](../docs/compliance/)** — EU regulatory compliance templates and procedures

## Getting Help

- **Bug reports:** [Open a bug report](https://github.com/rmednitzer/ai-stack/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- **Feature requests:** [Open a feature request](https://github.com/rmednitzer/ai-stack/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
- **Security vulnerabilities:** Follow the [coordinated disclosure process](../SECURITY.md) — do not open a public issue

## Before Opening an Issue

1. Check the [Troubleshooting section](../HOWTO.md#19-troubleshooting) in the How-To Guide
2. Search [existing issues](https://github.com/rmednitzer/ai-stack/issues) for duplicates
3. Run `helm lint .` and include the output in your report
